name: Family Records
description: One place for the paperwork and the details that follow a child between homes — custody agreements, insurance cards, consent forms, plus sizes, allergies, doctor and school contacts. Records with an expiry date surface before they lapse.

source.query: SELECT id AS id, title AS title, category AS subtitle, expires_on AS when_at, child_id AS member_id FROM app_family_records__records WHERE expires_on = :today LIMIT 20
SELECT title AS title, category AS subtitle, expires_on AS at, child_id AS member_id FROM app_family_records__records WHERE expires_on IS NOT NULL AND expires_on >= :today ORDER BY expires_on LIMIT 3
